remarks: Welcome to 18.2 acres of pure, untouched tranquility. Nestled in the heart of Granger, NY, this beautiful property serves as a quiet, private sanctuary where nature takes center stage. From the moment you arrive via the easy-access entrance, you will feel a world away from it all.For the serious hunter, this land is an absolute dream. It features a robust network of trails that allow you to explore every corner of your acreage effortlessly. The property has been carefully managed to attract and sustain local game, boasting established deer food plots and wildlife galore. Your hunting season is fully covered with an included hunting blind and a few tree stands already strategically positioned for optimal vantage points.The outdoor lifestyle is elevated here with premium amenities. Process your harvest comfortably on-site at the custom stainless steel outdoor kitchen, built to withstand the elements. Gather and swap stories around the camp area, which features two brand-new picnic tables. Skip the hassle of building or hauling a trailer—this property comes complete with two nice campers included, offering immediate comfort and a perfect base camp for you and your guests. Campers are 2103 Jayflight and 2006 Dutchman.
